structured_output.notes: Independent verification of U14 adapters identified 7 critical P1 defects (including security bypass of managed Antigravity->Codex execution hand-back, false success on timed-out partial turns, conversation cross-binding between stages, CLI flag injection via session_id starting with '-', and stage prefix forgery via carriage return), along with 4 P2 and 1 P3 defects. Test suite tests/test_u14_adapters.py suffers from severe author blind-spots, testing only exact string matches and clean UUIDs. Verdict is REWORK.
test_weaknesses: Author confirmation bias: implementation and tests were authored by the same agent (Claude), resulting in tests that only verify the exact happy/failure paths anticipated by the author.
Missing flag/option injection tests: test_resume_by_session_id_never_last only tests clean UUID and never tests session_id='--last' or session_id starting with '-'.

Missing conversation cross-binding test: test_one_conversation_per_task_and_tool only verifies (task, tool) collision, completely missing cross-task binding where the same conversation_id is bound to multiple distinct stages (R11 violation).

Missing casing / normalization tests in security guards: test_rejects_same_tool_reentry and test_managed_antigravity_cannot_hand_execution_back_to_codex only test lowercase names, completely missing that 'Antigravity' and 'Codex' bypass the safety guard.

Exact-string brittleness in timeout test: test_partial_timeout_warning_overrides_success tests only the verbatim string 'print timeout after 600s with turn in progress; returning partial output\n', missing variants like 'timed out' or 'time out' which result in false success.
Unrealistic capability detection test: test_detect_capabilities_requires_headless_flags uses synthetic isolated tokens without real-world CLI syntax like '--option=<val>' or punctuation.
Missing edge cases in usage parser: test_success_captures_conversation_and_usage never tests non-integer, NaN, Infinity, or bool values in JSON usage.
Missing newline/carriage-return injection tests for Codex: zero tests verify task_id format or prefix forging in build_codex_command.
